svg.title: Exhibit 01 — Two-Repo GitOps
svg.desc: A Flask and psutil monitoring app built by Jenkins into Docker images pushed to Amazon ECR, with a separate manifest repository that Argo CD syncs into Kubernetes. Illustrated with an animated schematic. Repository: github.com/Anup-Narkhede/cloud-native-monitoring-app-code.
svg.text: Ship by commit; let the cluster pull.
app repo → Jenkins → ECR · manifest repo → Argo CD → K8s
